<section id="portal" class="grain" aria-label="The Satyajit Ray cinematic journey">

  <div class="portal-grid">
    <div>
      <div class="eyebrow portal-kicker">ORIGINAL CINEMATIC EXHIBITION &nbsp; / &nbsp; VOL. 01</div>
      <h1 class="portal-title">The art of <i>becoming.</i></h1>
      <p class="portal-desc">Step inside the creative life of <strong style="color:#f4e2be">Satyajit Ray.</strong> Travel across time, discover the decisions behind the films, and experiment with cinema itself. Not just his story. An experience.</p>
      <div class="portal-ctas"><button class="goldbtn" id="beginBtn">Begin the experience &nbsp; ↗</button><button class="ghostbtn" id="tryLabBtn">Enter the director’s studio ↗</button><button class="ghostbtn portal-edit" id="tryEditBtn">Cut a scene ↗</button><button class="ghostbtn portal-scene" id="trySceneBtn">Enter a living scene ↗</button><button class="ghostbtn portal-worlds" id="tryWorldsBtn">Travel through time ↗</button></div>
    </div>

      <div class="exhibition-mark"><div class="orbit-ring"></div><div class="orbit-ring orbit-2"></div><div class="exhibition-index">01</div><div class="exhibition-detail"><span>AN INTERACTIVE EXHIBITION</span><b>SATYAJIT RAY</b><em>1921 — 1992</em></div></div>
      <div class="hero-vertical">A LIFE OBSERVED THROUGH CINEMA &nbsp; / &nbsp; VOLUME ONE</div>
    </div>
  </div>

</section>
<main id="experience" class="hidden">

  <section class="view active" id="journeyView">
    <div class="chapter-head">
      <div class="chapter-stage grain" id="chapterStage"><div class="stage-art" aria-hidden="true"></div><canvas id="storyCanvas" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><div class="stage-shade"></div><div class="stage-content"><div class="stage-top"><span class="stage-framecode">ORIGIN / CINEMA JOURNAL · PLATE 0<span id="plateNumber">1</span></span><span class="eyebrow" id="stageEyebrow">ACT I · THE BEGINNING</span><span class="frame-badge" id="stageYear">1921—1939</span></div><div class="stage-main"><span class="stage-act" id="stageMicro">ACT ONE / SIX</span><h1 class="stage-heading" id="stageTitle">The world before film</h1><p class="stage-deck" id="stageDeck">An eye for stories.</p></div><div class="stage-bottom"><button class="scene-explore" id="stageProject">◉ &nbsp; EXPLORE A MOMENT IN FULLSCREEN</button><span class="smallcaps" id="sceneCounter">01 / 06 &nbsp; · &nbsp; THE STORY CONTINUES</span><div class="stage-controls"><button class="round-arrow" id="chapterPrev" aria-label="Previous chapter">←</button><button class="round-arrow" id="chapterNext" aria-label="Next chapter">→</button></div></div></div></div>
      <aside class="side-panel"><div class="side-title"><b>THE SIX ACTS</b><span>1921–1992</span></div><div class="act-rail" id="actRail"></div><div class="rail-quote">“Artistic lives are rarely straight lines.” <span>OUR EDITORIAL LENS, NOT A RAY QUOTATION</span></div></aside>
    </div>
    <div class="wide-wrap chapter-under"><div class="section-mini">ENTER THE ARCHIVE / VERIFIED MILESTONES</div><div class="chapter-text-grid"><div class="chapter-body"><h2 id="articleTitle">A world of images</h2><div id="articleBody"></div><div class="citeinline" id="chapterSources"></div><div class="chapter-actions"><button id="bookmarkBtn" class="ghostbtn">♡ Save this act</button><button id="jumpStudio" class="ghostbtn">Step into the studio →</button><button id="jumpEdit" class="ghostbtn">Edit a sequence →</button><button id="jumpScene" class="ghostbtn">Enter the living scene →</button><button id="jumpWorlds" class="ghostbtn">Travel through four worlds →</button></div></div><aside class="contextcard"><div class="eyebrow">BEHIND THE DECISION</div><h3 id="insightTitle"></h3><p id="insightText"></p><button class="lessonbtn" id="revealBtn" aria-expanded="false">Uncover the creative lesson ↓</button><div class="reveal hidden" id="lessonText"></div></aside></div></div>
    <section class="timeline-section"><div class="timeline-inner"><div class="timeline-top"><div><div class="eyebrow">INTERACTIVE HISTORY</div><h2>Scrub through a life.</h2></div><p>Move the timeline. Every date reveals a milestone and takes you to its chapter. History should feel connected, not scattered.</p></div><div class="time-surface"><label class="sr-only" for="timelineScrub">Choose a milestone</label><input type="range" class="scrub" id="timelineScrub" min="0" max="11" step="1" value="0"/><div class="tickline" id="timeTicks"></div><div class="moment"><div class="moment-year" id="momentYear">1921</div><div class="moment-copy"><h3 id="momentTitle"></h3><p id="momentBody"></p></div><div class="moment-actions"><a id="momentLink" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Read source ↗</a><button id="openProjector" class="pillbtn">Open the screening room ↗</button></div></div></div></div></section>
  </section>
  <section class="view" id="studioView"><div class="wide-wrap"><div class="lab-hero"><div class="eyebrow">YOU ARE BEHIND THE CAMERA · INTERACTIVE EXERCISE 001</div><h1 class="bigtitle">Same moment.<br/><i>Different meaning.</i></h1><p class="lead">Imagine two children noticing a distant train. Experiment with shot size, time of day and movement. Notice how the framing changes the information and feeling available to the viewer. This is an original simulation, not a recreated Ray film frame.</p></div>
    <div class="lab-layout"><div class="lab-screen grain" id="labScreen"><canvas id="labCanvas" aria-label="Original animated illustration of people watching a distant train"></canvas><div class="screen-vig"></div><div class="lab-screen-top"><div class="rec-label"><span class="red-dot"></span><span id="labShotTag">SHOT / WIDE</span></div><div class="rec-label" id="labLightTag">LIGHT / GOLDEN HOUR</div></div><div class="lab-subtitle" id="labSubtitle">Observe the person and their world.</div><div class="director-monitor-tag">DIRECTOR’S VIEWFINDER <span>◆</span> ORIGINAL SIMULATION</div></div><div class="lab-controls"><div class="control-set"><h3>01 / CAMERA DISTANCE</h3><div class="seg"><button data-shot="wide" class="selected">Wide</button><button data-shot="medium">Medium</button><button data-shot="close">Close</button></div><div class="control-caption">Camera distance changes what information the audience can see.</div></div><div class="control-set"><h3>02 / ATMOSPHERE</h3><div class="seg"><button data-light="golden" class="selected">Golden</button><button data-light="blue">Twilight</button><button data-light="mono">B&amp;W</button></div><div class="control-caption">This is an illustration of lighting and grading choices, not a historical reconstruction.</div></div><div class="control-set"><h3>03 / FILM LANGUAGE</h3><div class="toggle-row"><span style="font-size:12px">Composition grid</span><button id="gridSwitch" class="switch" role="switch" aria-checked="false" aria-label="Toggle composition grid"></button></div><div class="toggle-row" style="margin-top:13px"><span style="font-size:12px">Scene movement</span><button id="moveSwitch" class="switch on" role="switch" aria-checked="true" aria-label="Toggle scene movement"></button></div></div><div class="control-set comparison-set"><h3>04 / DIRECTOR’S COMPARISON</h3><div class="toggle-row"><span style="font-size:12px">Split the frame</span><button role="switch" aria-checked="false" class="switch" id="compareSwitch" aria-label="Compare original wide shot with your changes"></button></div><label id="compareLabel" class="compare-label hidden" for="compareRange">Drag to compare <span id="compareValue">50%</span></label><input type="range" id="compareRange" min="10" max="90" value="50" class="compare-range hidden" aria-label="Move before-after comparison divider"/></div>
    <button class="ghostbtn" id="captureFrame">↓ Save your cinematic frame</button>
    <button class="ghostbtn" id="resetStudio">↺ Reset experiment</button></div></div>
    <div class="lab-analysis"><div><div class="section-mini">WHAT YOU CHANGED</div><h2 class="analysis-title" id="analysisTitle"></h2><p class="analysis-par" id="analysisCopy"></p></div><div><div class="section-mini">DIRECTOR'S NOTE</div><h2 class="analysis-title" id="analysisQuestion"></h2><p class="analysis-par" id="analysisQuestionCopy"></p></div></div>
    <div class="experience-choices"><div class="eyebrow">A CREATIVE DECISION · NO SINGLE CORRECT ANSWER</div><h2 class="sectiontitle" style="font:normal clamp(33px,4vw,56px) var(--serif);margin:18px 0 24px">How should the audience <i>discover</i> the train?</h2><div class="exercise-grid" id="decisionOptions"><button class="option-card" data-choice="anticipation"><b>Build anticipation</b><span>Let viewers see the distant railway first and wait for the characters' reaction.</span></button><button class="option-card" data-choice="surprise"><b>Reveal suddenly</b><span>Stay close to a character, then cut to the train at the moment of discovery.</span></button><button class="option-card" data-choice="curiosity"><b>Follow curiosity</b><span>Show a reaction, then gradually reveal what has caught their attention.</span></button></div><div class="exercise-feedback" id="decisionFeedback" aria-live="polite">Choose an approach. We'll explore the possible effect—not grade your artistic taste.</div></div>
  </div></section>
  
  

<section class="view" id="worldsView" aria-label="Explore four researched moments of Satyajit Ray's creative life">
 <div class="worldstage" id="worldStage" data-world="0" tabindex="0" aria-label="Cinematic world; arrow keys switch years">
  <div class="world-photo" id="worldPhoto" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="world-next-photo" id="worldNextPhoto" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="world-light" aria-hidden="true"></div><canvas class="world-particles" id="worldParticles" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><div class="world-veil" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="world-grain" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="world-topline"><span>ORIGIN / THE WORLDS BETWEEN · AN INTERACTIVE CINEMA EXHIBITION</span><span>RESEARCH BASED · ARTWORK IMAGINED</span></div>
  <div class="world-heading"><div class="eyebrow" id="worldEra">I / THE GRAPHIC ARTIST</div><div class="world-year" id="worldYear">1943</div><h1 id="worldTitle">Before a camera, a pencil.</h1><p id="worldDeck">An illustration desk is where a future filmmaker sharpens his eye.</p><div class="world-hint">◉ FIND THREE HIDDEN STORIES IN THE SCENE</div></div>

   <aside class="living-secondary">
    <div class="living-side-section"><span class="eyebrow">A VERIFIED MOMENT</span><h3>The field changed overnight.</h3><p>Ray's archive recounts that his crew returned the next Sunday to discover cattle had eaten the <em>kaash</em> flowers. The scene could only be completed when they grew again the following season.</p><a href="https://satyajitray.org/making-of-pather-panchali/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Read the production account ↗</a></div>

But we can study the documented circumstances, make choices ourselves, and learn to see how creative possibilities emerge from real constraints.</p><button class="ghostbtn" id="livingToEdit">Continue with this scene in the Editing Theatre →</button></div>

function restore(key,fallback){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key))??fallback}catch{return fallback}}
const state={entered:false,view:'journey',act:0,mid:0,visited:new Set(restore('origin2-visited',[])),saved:new Set(restore('origin2-saved',[])),notes:restore('origin2-notes',''),shot:'wide',light:'golden',grid:false,move:true,network:3,motion:!matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches,decision:null};
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem('origin2-visited',JSON.stringify([...state.visited]));localStorage.setItem('origin2-saved',JSON.stringify([...state.saved]));localStorage.setItem('origin2-notes',JSON.stringify(state.notes))}catch{}}
let toastTimer;function toast(msg){$('#toast').textContent=msg;$('#toast').classList.add('show');clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>$('#toast').classList.remove('show'),2400)}
function enter(view='journey'){state.entered=true;if(view==='journey'){state.visited.add(state.act);save();updateProgress()};$('#portal').classList.add('hidden');$('#experience').classList.remove('hidden');$('#homeBtn').classList.remove('hidden');switchView(view);window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'});resizeAll()}
function portal(){state.entered=false;$('#experience').classList.add('hidden');$('#portal').classList.remove('hidden');$('#homeBtn').classList.add('hidden');$('#headerSubtitle').textContent='THE CINEMATIC EDITION · 006';window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'});resizeAll()}
function switchView(id){state.view=id;$$('.navtab').forEach(el=>{el.classList.toggle('active',el.dataset.view===id);el.setAttribute('aria-current',el.dataset.view===id?'page':'false')});$$('.view').forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle('active',el.id===id+'View'));$('#headerSubtitle').textContent=id==='journey'?'SATYAJIT RAY · THE SIX ACTS':id==='studio'?'THE STUDIO · ORIGINAL SIMULATION':id==='connections'?'THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE WORK':'YOUR PRIVATE FIELD NOTES';window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'});if(id==='studio')updateStudio();if(id==='notebook')renderNotebook();resizeAll()}
function updateProgress(){const p=state.visited.size/6*100;$('#progFill').style.width=p+'%';$('#progText').textContent=state.visited.size+' OF 6 ACTS'}
